title: Residency Drift Detector + Audit Snapshot Builder for Hosted API
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Customers who require data residency guarantees for Hosted API need continuous evidence that tenant data is placed and retained according to their policy. Existing controls allow region pinning and retention profiles, but we lack a lightweight detector that surfaces 'residency drift' (requests routed outside declared affinity zones) and an on-demand audit snapshot that packages placement, retention state, and transfer logs for compliance reviewers.

Goal: Ship a paired feature set: (1) Residency Drift Detector — an alerting/telemetry surface that detects when routing decisions or fallback policies cause tenant inference to execute outside declared regions or tiers beyond a configurable threshold; (2) Audit Snapshot Builder — a one-click export that compiles per-tenant placement evidence, retention configuration history, relevant routing decisions, and signed timestamps suitable for auditor consumption.

Scope: Hosted API only (not Dedicated/Private in this ticket). The detector should support configurable detection windows and thresholds, attach to existing alerting backends, and surface incidents in Console and webhook feeds. The snapshot builder should produce an auditable ZIP with JSON manifests and links to logs/dashboards; it should be available from tenant Settings > Compliance.

Non-goals: Full cross-region replay of payloads, long-term storage of snapshots beyond customer retention, and automatic remediation (auto-heal) — those are separate follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Residency Drift Detector emits an event when >X% of a tenant's requests are routed outside their pinned regions for Y minutes (configurable in UI)
Detector exposes metric series (tenant_id, drift_rate, window) to our metrics cluster and a Console tile that lists tenants with >threshold drift

Audit Snapshot Builder creates a signed artifact containing: tenant residency policy, retention profile history, per-request routing samples (redacted), recent KV/cache placement metadata, and links to relevant logs/dashboards
Export artifact contains cryptographic proof (signatures/timestamps) and a human-readable summary; generated artifacts are verifiable by the compliance team
UI: Settings page shows detector status, drift threshold config, and an Export button with export history and retention policy

End-to-end smoke test (QA): create a tenant pinned to region A, intentionally route a small percentage to region B via a simulated failover, and validate detector alerts and export contains the sample events

risk: Medium. Primary risks are: sampling bias in routing logs leading to false positives, export generation costs (IO/CPU), and legal/regulatory requirements for signed artifacts. Mitigations include sampling heuristics, export quotas, and KMS-backed signing with replayable manifests.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): internal-only detector + export for Redwood compliance and two pilot customers; Phase 2: gated release to all tenants with conservative defaults; Phase 3: add auto-remediation and Dedicated/Private support. Feature flag for Export API and detector controls. Monitor drift false-positive rate and export latency during beta.
qa_plan: Create tenant fixtures with explicit pin configs. Simulate routing failovers using the staging route simulator. Verify detector triggers at configured thresholds. Validate exported artifact JSON manifests against schema and verify signatures using our KMS verifier. Run load test for export generation at 100 concurrent requests to measure queuing behavior.
